items.summary: Timeline view is renamed Roadmap and moves under the Plan tab.
items.source_line: The Timeline view is now called Roadmap, and it lives under the new Plan tab.

items.summary: A group can now be an approver; any one member can approve.
items.source_line: You can now assign a group as an approver. Any one member of the group can approve.

items.summary: Guest access is off by default for new workspaces; admins turn it on in Settings > Security.
items.source_line: Guest access is now off by default for new workspaces. Admins can turn it on in Settings > Security.

items.summary: CSV export moves from Reports > Export to the Share menu on any report; PDF export is new.
items.source_line: CSV export has moved from Reports > Export to the Share menu on every report. You can also export to PDF.

items.summary: Projects with 5,000+ tasks load up to 40% faster.
items.source_line: Projects with more than 5,000 tasks now load up to 40% faster.
